hit: Take one more card. Example: 10 + 6 takes a 3 and becomes 19.
stand: End play on the current hand without taking another card. Example: finish with 17; you receive no further cards.
double: Double the wager, take exactly one card, then stand. Example: an initial practice unit becomes two units and you receive just one card.
split: Separate a matching pair into two independently played hands. Example: 8 + 8 becomes two hands, each starting with one 8.
surrender: Give up the hand and lose half of its wager when the rules allow it. Example: give up a one-unit hand and lose half a unit.
hardHand: A hand with no ace currently counted as 11. Example: 10 + 6 is hard 16; A + 6 + 10 is hard 17.
softHand: A hand containing an ace currently counted as 11. Example: A + 6 is soft 17; after a 10 arrives, the ace becomes 1 and the hand is hard 17.
runningCount: The cumulative total of the Hi-Lo tags of every exposed card. Example: start at 0; exposed 2, K, 7 change the count by +1, −1, 0 and leave RC at 0.
trueCount: Running count divided by the estimated decks remaining.
penetration: The percentage of a shoe dealt before the shuffle card is reached.
